single_session_founder_ruling.outer_enclosure: Must remain sealed and unopened from cycle start through cycle completion; any manual opening mid-build terminates qualification as a single session.

automated integration of externally manufactured components such as semiconductor chips, pre-staged without opening the process enclosure
prohibited_mid_cycle: operator opening or de-sealing outer process enclosure
manual assembly/repositioning requiring outer seal breach
single_session_founder_ruling.provenance_requirement: Keep direct-printed content separate from vendor-made or preloaded components; a sealed one-session complete Butter Bot need not be composed of 100% directly printed parts, but all-component printing research remains in scope.
single_session_founder_ruling.cross_product: Design automated tooling/component-access interface for wider product families, not only Butter Bot.

dual_track_station_and_motion.enclosure: Maintain sealed outer chamber throughout cycle; internal robotic tool swaps/pick-place and external digital communications through appropriately sealed feedthroughs permitted.

bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.redundancy: Include appropriate redundancy, fail-safe and safety provisions for each class based on hazard and reliability assessment.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.status_caveat: No completed prototype, validated 4D feature implementation, commercial costing, industrial safety sign-off or physical runtime permission is implied.

parallel_program_and_circularity.startup_handshake: Discover parts and report per-operation capability and limits; keep verified safe modes available but require adequate protection for hazardous functions

parallel_program_and_circularity.recovered_first: Prioritise qualified reused/upcycled material and parts; requalify recovered Mark hardware for its target use

offline_controller_founder_ruling.principle: Every printer includes a unique offline-capable CGX device identity, deterministic motion/process controller and local capability handshake.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.ai_assistance: Optional add-on, never required for ordinary classical printer operation.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.cloud: Optional add-on; no mandatory cloud connectivity for core verified printer functions.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.identity_scope: A per-machine identity and local configuration/traceability record, not CGX root authority or privileged access.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.capabilities: Actual enabled operations derive from installed hardware, evidence, limits and verified safety protections, not from product-tier marketing.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.extension: Customer chooses roaming, tool sets, printer-in-printer capability and AI modules; classic fixed configurations remain valid.
offline_controller_founder_ruling.safety: Hardware protections and deterministic local interlocks must not depend on an AI response or internet connectivity.

cgx_individual_printer_configuration.model: CGX recognises an individual device with a distinct identifier, capacity, tools, physical modules and verified capabilities.
cgx_individual_printer_configuration.constraint: No mandatory universal docking geometry or standard cosmetic form; each variant must satisfy actual safety and function constraints.

cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.record: A discoverable lightweight CGX machine skeleton/manifest identifying what a device is, its label/name and intended configuration, without requiring Windows, a heavyweight OS, AI or internet services.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.setup: Assign a base/model identity at manufacture or from open skeleton schematics; invite the user to personalise its name and select desired features at setup.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.hierarchy: Machine and hardware components share a known CGX information substrate with parent, child and sibling links comparable to the existing workbook/LightSpeed organisation; expandability is not contingent on an optional module being installed.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.cross_spaces: Link identities/capabilities to workspaces, dataspaces and filespaces with evidence references, revision history and owner-controlled information exchange.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.physical_control: Deterministic control firmware/runtime remains necessary for real actuators and safety interlocks; CGX skeleton is not in itself an actuator driver, replacement for needed embedded software, or permission to change root authority.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.modularity: Founder rejected a separate CGX individual identity for each passive physical component. Electronic hardware may be represented as CGX digital individuals; nuts, screws, bolts, printed brackets and other non-electronic parts are child components of the owning CGX individual, with attributes and optional material passports/lot provenance inside the parent's hierarchy. No separate independent CGX entity is required.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.source_scope: PrintSpace owner-level design record only. No change to cognigrex.root.json, existing CGX schema, runtime or other owner-managed workbooks.
cgx_skeleton_device_substrate.ontological_clarification: CGX is the digital entity/filespace representation of a Cognigrex individual (analogised by founder to biological individuals within Cognigrex). The physical machine and electronic equipment are represented as digital individuals with families/relationships, while passive parts are nested structural or BOM children. Do not equate a CGX file record with electronic hardware's control firmware.

butter_bot_founder_direction.data_sovereignty_founder_gate: Still unapproved: local-first record ownership and cloud sync opt-in; not decided by skeleton clarification alone.

cgx_family_and_universal_technology_reco.definition_scope: CGX global families define metrics, units, fastener types and technology classes as reusable referenced semantic objects, including passive items. A printer's CGX instance contains installed components as children/references. An independently functional machine identity is distinct from a reusable type record.
cgx_family_and_universal_technology_reco.no_date_priority: Newer document is not presumed truer. Check meaning, authoritative owner, source quality, model state, evidence, conditions, equations and SI dimensions; hybridise genuinely compatible aspects and hold irreducible contradictions for source-owner review.
cgx_family_and_universal_technology_reco.universal_printer: Universal technology scope means endeavouring to make any physically lawful technology, not a machine that can print a universe nor a claim of current universal physical capability.
cgx_family_and_universal_technology_reco.scope_vs_configuration: 4D defining feature set remains a mandatory development objective for the architecture. Individual delivered printer modules are optional where appropriate, with exact operating capability bounded by tested configuration and safeguards.

butter_bot_founder_direction.nested_printer_identity_gate: FOUNDER_YES_2026-10-08: nested functionally capable mini-printers may hold their own CGX digital individual within the parent printer's assembly hierarchy, analogised to the role of a nut/bolt; do not infer compulsory universal independent network access, top-level authority or physical modular connector.

universal_release_principle.universal: Any technology consistent with applicable physical laws remains an R&D/manufacturing ambition, not a current claim of ability.
universal_release_principle.what_4d_means: Printed 3D objects with environmental/stimulus-driven state or property changes over time; embedded functional and solid-state/wearable technology part of the proposed process remit. Time-dependent behaviour requires measured stimulus-response qualification.
universal_release_principle.public_claim_rule: Only state as printable/produced/certified the specific combinations of material, tool, environment, process, part and quality actually verified. Preserve pending ambitions without advertising them as demonstrated.
universal_release_principle.naming: Founder references established 'New Neutrals' label for terrestrial/non-primary interplanetary supply-chain technologies (examples: wearable glasses and road paint); confirm actual source spelling and owning taxonomy before canonical promotion.
universal_release_principle.cross_domain: Mark/Luke and interplanetary systems retain owner-specific scope, product identities and separate engineering proof.
universal_release_principle.safety: No physical printer operating authorisation or qualification implied.

component_replacement_and_dbr.replace_rule: A like-for-like replacement of a non-critical item with equivalent specification and verified condition is logged; full system requalification is not automatic.
component_replacement_and_dbr.qualification_trigger: Changed functional/safety/material/geometry/process conditions, unknown equivalence, hazard-critical containment, adverse wear, sensor/calibration drift, firmware/energy/pressure/thermal variation or owner-qualification policy trigger appropriate targeted checks.
component_replacement_and_dbr.trace: Printer CGX device history/DBR receipt chain should provide current configuration, substitutions, component material provenance where necessary, process and function history, repairs, adjustments and source of evidence.
component_replacement_and_dbr.cache: Cache clearing is contemplated but its exact effect on durable receipts, personal data and owner/transfer records is not yet authorised; physical safety logs and legally required trace cannot be silently lost.
component_replacement_and_dbr.no_implementation_claim: Founder scope only; no validated on-device DBR integration, audit retention or secure storage attested.

cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.local_mode: A printer using local storage alone may lose its DBR history when its only storage is cleared.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.network_mode: On a smart network, the owner is prompted to either clear its records or compact several Digitally Backed Receipts into a single DBR handoff held on the network.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.terminology: DBR means Digitally Backed Receipt; DBI in the voice transcript was a mispronunciation and is not a separate proposed format.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.constraints: Network handoff, integrity verification, privacy permissions and any mandatory retention still need implementation and separate owner approval.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.success_rule: If compacting multiple DBRs to one network DBR, printer internally validates network acceptance and durable receipt integrity before clearing local history. Routine success is automatic and need not display a confirmation.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.failure_rule: On unsuccessful acceptance, preserve local DBRs and maintain a LIVE_PENDING network handoff. Retry automatically when a network becomes available, using a persistent local outbox and restart-resumable idempotent transaction until a verified receipt acknowledgement arrives. Do not clear local history until verified completion.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.offline_limit: If network is unreachable, transfer cannot occur; locally queue the handoff and retry on connectivity restoration. Do not claim that data has reached network without accepted provider receipt.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.error_visibility: Ordinary retries and successful completion should not interrupt user with prompts; material prolonged failure, inability to retain local receipts, security issues, or user-requested diagnostic status must remain inspectable and surfaced when necessary.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.safe_architecture: Candidate state machine: LOCAL_PREPARED -> SUBMIT_PENDING/RETRY -> NETWORK_ACK_PENDING -> VERIFIED_NETWORK_DBR -> LOCAL_CLEAR_ELIGIBLE; any failure preserves prior locally verified data and returns to pending without losing sequence/lineage. Verification should bind digest, child receipt count/IDs, destination and commit acknowledgement, subject to privacy/retention policy.
cgx_device_reset_retention_founder_direc.implementation_hold: Requirements only: no network transfer agent, compaction algorithm, integrity receipt validator, scheduler, deletion code, physical system, or CGX root schema is deployed by this commit.

source_contract_reconciliation.findings: Existing CGX source documentation binds Object ID, State Root, DBR Root, event head and significant checkpoints; offline replicas reconcile roots/ancestry. A network compact DBR must not claim it can restore data absent from its closure.

accepted_architecture: Start Bootstrap PrintCeptor as smallest safe functional core and expand iteratively Ship-of-Theseus style, preserving all planned 4D technology capabilities as trackable goals; successor purpose-specific printer follows measured validation.
Every model designed and simulated digitally even where actual build depends on financing, sourced equipment, collaboration and staged qualification.

Dual arm minimum with baseless/seed-anchor manufacturing when mechanically feasible, interchangeable print/pick/drill/scan/handling functions, extensible robotic modules, coordinated child printers with own CGX identities.
Configurable bays do not automatically act as printers; independent child printers may process multiple functional subassemblies concurrently behind independent verified environmental barriers.

Primary sealed transparent chamber; retractable internal barriers, separate material/spool service cavity, interface-equipped programmable floor/panel modules, gravity-fed baseline first and microgravity later independently qualified.

Post-Mix feed families and composition/substrate dilution controlled from PMX-MAT-001 and companion feed heat dilution matrix; user requested broad H1–H20 research scope but physical process windows remain research.
Distributed cameras/scanners and automated checks; multiple optical views do not prove computed tomography or internal material quality without qualified volumetric NDE.

Automatic feeder calibration/scan, start-up system metrology and conditional recalibration; C0 deterministic safety, C1 offline contextual planning, C2 optional network heavy work, no AI control of actuators/interlocks.
Emergency mode conditional on actual contents, person location, exhaust containment, qualified gas species and operator safety; do not use spool cavity as unqualified noxious-gas dump.
Maintenance self-upgrades, modular recovery/reuse, contextual safe use across public/specialist programmes, per-component/child DBR history; no full replacement cycle mandated.

Externally sourced and printed modules are separate lineage and acceptance states. Butter Bot requires pre-unseal functional verification when safe; full single-sealed-session integration remains primary proof goal.

Desktop visual reference white/orange with clear side-feed cavity, dual articulated arms, conditional display and optional screenless/minimal devices; two stock base models then custom/community classes.
Rollout objective public libraries/state university partners and industry skilled operators, conditional on actual agreements, resources, funding, hazard approvals and owner release.

cross_source_dependencies.rule: Do not replace deterministic recipe mass conservation, feed certificates, substrate dilution or process-structure-property evidence with visual-only simulation; no second postmix solver.
Consume recursive dependency/physics and capability handshake with identified owner review; no active printer implied.
Object identity, child and family references, offline C0 safety, durable DBR and source lineage not replaced.

resolved_by_scope_not_recency.issue: universal 4D printer vs static screw sorter drawer
resolved_by_scope_not_recency.resolution: Manufacturing system capability is distinct from a specific output's strict time-responsive material properties or integrated-function test. Record output category separately.

resolved_by_scope_not_recency.issue: P9 'no balance' vs physical mass balance
resolved_by_scope_not_recency.resolution: Do not impose a manual balancing workbook when simulation/compiler can maintain mass conservation; digital planning must still account for feed and losses.

resolved_by_scope_not_recency.issue: camera coverage vs CT-style internal inspection
resolved_by_scope_not_recency.resolution: Multiview optical coverage can estimate external surface and pose; internal defects need qualified volumetric/NDE modality.

resolved_by_scope_not_recency.resolution: Secondary internal partitions may be dynamic when qualified; changing the primary rated boundary still requires independent pressure/structure review.

open_founder_gates.question: For the first complete 4D printer release, which first functional acceptance article is authoritative: a powered Butter Bot in one sealed cycle, a printer-made child printer performing a qualified print, or both in staged order?
